comment: A history with consolidated archives (homecontrol#56): the raw ring and up to four archives. history.budget covers the RAM: 8 bytes per raw sample and per archive its open slot and an hour of pending slots, (ceil(3600 / resolution) + 2) * 32 bytes (96 from an hour on): 577 * 8 + 96 + 96 = 4808. history.archiveBudget covers the flash: 4096 bytes per segment of 127 slots, 745 and 731 slots are 6 segments each: 49152.
